title: Core: motion guide path snapping
description: When a layer is type='guided' and its parent layer is type='guide', getTweenedFrame should already snap the object to the guide path. Read packages/core/src/engine/tween.ts and packages/core/src/engine/guidepath.ts. Add unit tests verifying: guided layer object follows guide path at t=0 (start), t=0.5 (midpoint), t=1.0 (end). The object x/y should match samplePath output at those t values. Add to packages/core/src/engine/__tests__/guidepath.test.ts.
